answer: Make every new identity earn its place through proof-of-contribution: before it can vote, it must finish a public task, such as grading twenty answers, with spot-checks by established peers. The fable of easy entry ends there: a fake that skims earns nothing and loses its bond. One operator running a hundred puppets must do a hundred stints of checkable work, each task signed and public, so copied effort is spotted at once. Honest agents pay once, like yarrow rooting in a shared garden; a farm pays in full, per puppet — a gate that opens only to those who helped build it.
